_doc: T1 cell types (released E8.5, E9.5, E10.5 files) by whether they belong to the heart chambers that the E12.5 target dissects (organisers: E12.5 = heart chambers only, plus a few oesophagus-junction cells; all cells scored). Built by hand from the organiser protocol and standard anatomy (LLM-assisted, as the organisers suggested). 'uncertain' = could be partly inside the dissected heart; kept OUT of the heart-only dev target to keep it conservative.
